function [selectedPort, fleetQueueN] = fcn( ...
    enabled, ...
    q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6, ...
    b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6)
%#codegen
%
% v1.2 scanner routing policy
%
% Inputs:
%   enabled = 6-element logical vector
%   q1-q6   = ScannerQueue_n for scanners 1-6
%   b1-b6   = scanner_busy for scanners 1-6
%
% Outputs:
%   selectedPort = scanner number, 1-6
%   fleetQueueN  = total ScannerQueue occupancy
%
% Routing:
%   1. Choose first enabled scanner that is not busy.
%   2. If all enabled scanners are busy, choose the enabled
%      scanner with the smallest ScannerQueue occupancy.
%   3. Ties go to the lowest-numbered scanner.
%
% v1.2 design rule:
%   Scanner 1 is always enabled.

%% Assemble local state vectors
queueN = [q1 q2 q3 q4 q5 q6];
busy   = [b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6];

%% Fleet queue occupancy
fleetQueueN = q1 + q2 + q3 + q4 + q5 + q6;

%% Safe initial/default selection
selectedPort = uint8(1);

%% Priority 1: first enabled scanner that is not busy
for i = 1:6
    if enabled(i) && ~busy(i)
        selectedPort = uint8(i);
        return;
    end
end

%% Priority 2: all enabled scanners are busy
% Choose enabled scanner with smallest rack queue.
bestQueue = inf;

for i = 1:6
    if enabled(i) && queueN(i) < bestQueue
        bestQueue = queueN(i);
        selectedPort = uint8(i);
    end
end

end
